caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl shown from both a top-down and a side view. The bowl’s interior is colored in shades of brown, ranging from dark reddish-brown near the edges to a lighter, almost tan hue toward the center, suggesting a clay or ceramic material. At the center of the bowl’s interior, there is a raised circular medallion featuring the relief of a human bust with a short, rounded hairstyle, encircled by a ring of small stars or dots. Below the bust, within the medallion, there is an inscription in a banner-like recess. The exterior, shown in the side view below the top view, is shaded in darker browns and charcoal grays, illustrating the bowl’s curved form and giving it a sense of depth. The composition sits on a plain, off-white background bordered by a faint pencil or ink outline. The artist’s name, “Yolande DeLasser,” is signed in the bottom right corner.
title: Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
